goal_intent: book one table for ten on Saturday evening

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m calling to see if you have any availability for a group get-together this coming Saturday evening. I’m planning a little reunion and hoping to make it special!
Thanks! There will be ten of us—it's a pretty lively bunch, and we're all really looking forward to catching up.

Thanks so much for explaining everything! Before we finish up, I just want to make sure—will we all be seated together at one table in the private room? That’s really important to us, as chatting together is half the fun.

That sounds perfect, thank you! I think that covers everything for now—I’ll look out for the follow-up email from your events team. Appreciate your help! 

[END OF CALL]
